title: Potion of Healing

sources.title: Potions
markers: do not lose any effectiveness when thrown

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to restore 2d4 + 2 HP and remove Burning. Throw as an Action to create a 3 ft-radius healing splash.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle to restore 2d4 + 2 HP and remove Burning.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw one bottle up to 60 ft to apply 2d4 + 2 healing in a 3 ft-radius area at the landing point and end Burning on creatures affected by the splash.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Rogue's Morsel with any Suspension through Alchemy.
fields.Creative use: Aim at the ground beside an ally to avoid hitting them with the bottle itself.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
